description: Edits the event's LIST of sounds the game picks from at random. Pass generation_ids to set the whole list at once (2-3 is a good amount for variety); or generation_id with mode: 'add' adds one, 'remove' removes one, 'only' replaces the list with one, null empties it. After choosing, the UNCHOSEN variations of this event are DELETED to keep the account clean (favorites, edited sounds and sounds used in another event are always kept); emptying the list deletes nothing.

event_id.description: The event (sound) whose list you edit, from get_entity, find_sounds or list_folders.

generation_id.description: One variation; with mode. Use generation_ids to pick several.

generation_ids.description: The full list to use, set at once (the unchosen rest is deleted).

mode.description: Only with generation_id: add (default) puts it in the list, remove takes it out, only makes it the single chosen one.

prune.description: false keeps the unchosen variations (the user may still pick another one).

name: choose_sound
title: Choose variation
